```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(googlesheets4)

url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BJR6o_kZH9YCPTlQtPgWaHZdYpI2c1VOJOsdPbb3bPU/edit?gid=1264107449#gid=1264107449"

df_incidence <- read_sheet(url, sheet = "sampling_sites") |>
  mutate(across(c(incidence_pct, elevation), as.numeric))

df_nymphs <- read_sheet(url, sheet = "nymph_morphology") |>
  mutate(instar = factor(instar),
         across(c(body_length_mm, body_width_mm), as.numeric))

df_adults <- read_sheet(url, sheet = "adult_morphology") |>
  mutate(sex = factor(sex))

df_life <- read_sheet(url, sheet = "life_cycle") |>
  mutate(instar = factor(instar))
```

# Incidence Analysis

```{r}
cor_pear <- cor.test(~ incidence_pct + elevation, data = df_incidence, method = "pearson")
m1 <- lm(incidence_pct ~ elevation, data = df_incidence)
cor_pear; summary(m1); confint(m1)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2)); plot(m1); par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
shapiro.test(residuals(m1)); lmtest::bptest(m1)

ci    <- confint(m1)["elevation", ]
p_txt <- if (cor_pear$p.value < 0.001) "< 0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", cor_pear$p.value)

label_txt <- sprintf(
  "Pearson: r = %.2f, p = %s\nLinear model: \u03B2 = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f\u2013%.3f), R\u00B2 = %.3f",
  cor_pear$estimate, p_txt, coef(m1)[["elevation"]], ci[1], ci[2], summary(m1)$r.squared
)

p_inc_alt <- ggplot(df_incidence, aes(elevation, incidence_pct)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = min(df_incidence$elevation), y = max(df_incidence$incidence_pct),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label = label_txt, size = 3.6) +
  labs(x = "Elevation (m a.s.l.)", y = "Incidence (%)") +
  theme_classic()

p_inc_alt
```

# Morphological analyses of nymphal instars

```{r}
table_nymphs <- df_nymphs |>
  pivot_longer(c(body_length_mm, body_width_mm),
               names_to = "Variable", values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(Instar = instar, Variable) |>
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(value)),
    Mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min  = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max  = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    CV   = SD / Mean * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Instar, Variable, n,
    `Mean ± SD` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Mean, SD),
    Range       = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", Min, Max),
    `CV (%)`    = round(CV, 2)
  )

table_nymphs

writexl::write_xlsx(table_nymphs, "table_nymphs.xlsx")
```

# Morphological analyses of adults

```{r}
table_adults <- df_adults |>
  pivot_longer(-sex, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = names(df_adults)[-1])) |>
  group_by(Variable, Sex = sex) |>
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(value)),
    Mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min  = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max  = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    CV   = SD / Mean * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Variable, Sex, n,
    `Mean ± SD` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Mean, SD),
    Range       = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", Min, Max),
    `CV (%)`    = round(CV, 2)
  )

table_adults

writexl::write_xlsx(table_adults, "table_adults.xlsx")
```

# Analysis of the life cycle

```{r}
table_life <- df_life |>
  mutate(instar = factor(instar,
                         levels = c("egg", "instar I", "instar II", "instar III",
                                    "instar IV", "instar V", "adult"))) |>
  group_by(Stage = instar) |>
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(duration_days)),
    Mean = mean(duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min  = min(duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max  = max(duration_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    CV   = SD / Mean * 100
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Stage, n,
    `Mean ± SD` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Mean, SD),
    Range       = sprintf("%d–%d", as.integer(Min), as.integer(Max)),
    `CV (%)`    = round(CV, 2)
  )

table_life

writexl::write_xlsx(table_life, "table_life.xlsx")
```
